title: 第1014章 传承开始第1013章 圣人也是怂货
content_zh:
听到天火圣人的回答，叶霄炎心中莫名生出几分认同感，竟觉得很有道理。
若是放在远古时代，除了玄帝与神境强者数量稍显稀少之外，其余强者恐怕真称得上是“天人不如狗，圣人满地走”。
那种年代，强者辈出，天地法则更为鼎盛，机缘与凶险并存，圣境存在或许远没有今日这般罕见。
不过，炎族既然会被天火圣人封印，那说明当年的炎族，恐怕也已经衰落到了极点。
否则，以炎族昔日的底蕴，怎会轻易落到被一尊圣人镇压封印的地步？
当然，这么一想，炎族倒也算运气不差。
至少，他们遇到的是天火圣人。
若是换成别的圣人，恐怕就不是封印那么简单了，直接灭族也不是没有可能。
真要那样，哪里还会有今日炎族的存在，更不可能还有他们这些后辈站在这里。
这么说来，炎族或许还真应该感谢天火圣人？
想到这里，叶霄炎自己先忍不住觉得有些好笑。
让炎族去感谢一位镇压了他们的圣人？
得了吧，估计他们恨天火圣人都来不及。
毕竟被封印了这么多年，任谁都不可能心平气和地接受这种结果。
就在叶霄炎心中思绪翻涌之际，天火圣人见他迟迟没有开口，不由得露出几分好奇之色，打量着他问道：“你很奇怪。”
“你和其他那些人，似乎不太一样。”
“你对我的传承好像并不怎么感兴趣，反倒是对那些已经过去的历史，格外在意。”
叶霄炎闻言，并没有立刻回答。
他只是抬头看向天火圣人，神色平静，随后继续问道：“我的那些同伴到哪里去了？”
天火圣人淡淡道：“他们现在都在传承之地外面。”

说到这里，他顿了顿，语气中透出一丝理所当然的冷意。
“毕竟我的传承，可不是什么阿猫阿狗都能接受的。”
叶霄炎听完，眉头微不可察地动了一下，似乎还想再问什么。
可天火圣人却已经直接抬手打断了他。
“好了，开始传承吧。”
“我这道神念所剩下的时间已经不多了。”
天火圣人说完，整个人的神情骤然肃然了不少。
他缓缓抬头，看向叶霄炎，眼神深邃而庄严，仿佛跨越了无尽岁月的沉寂，重新回到了当年那位镇压诸天八荒的绝世圣者模样。
下一刻，天火圣人低沉而宏大的声音，响彻在整片传承之地中，带着一种难以言喻的古老威严。
“吾乃天火圣人。”
“吾十五岁踏足修行，苦修七百载，破关入玄圣境；
再历一千五百载打磨，登顶玄圣巅峰，执掌天火权柄，威震诸天八荒！”
content_en:
Hearing the answer from the Heavenly Fire Sage, Ye Xiaoyan felt a sense of recognition inexplicably and felt that it made sense.
If we place it in the ancient times, except for the slightly rare Emperor Xuan and the powerful ones in the divine realm, the rest of the powerful people may really be called "human beings are inferior to dogs, and saints are everywhere."
In that era, strong men emerged in large numbers, the laws of heaven and earth were more prosperous, opportunities and dangers coexisted, and the existence of the holy realm was perhaps far less rare than it is today.
However, since the Yan Clan will be sealed by the Heavenly Fire Saint, it means that the Yan Clan back then may have declined to the extreme.
Otherwise, with the Yan clan's past background, how could it be so easy to be suppressed and sealed by a saint?
Of course, thinking about it this way, the Yan Clan is not bad luck.
At least, they met the Heavenly Fire Saint.
If it were another saint, it might not be as simple as sealing, and it would not be impossible to directly exterminate the clan.
If that were to happen, the Yan Clan would still exist today, let alone their juniors standing here.
In this case, maybe the Yan Clan should really thank the Heavenly Fire Saint?
Thinking of this, Ye Xiaoyan couldn't help but feel a little funny.
Let the Yan Clan thank a saint who suppressed them?
Come on, I guess it’s too late for them to hate the Heavenly Fire Saint.
After all, it was impossible for anyone to accept this result calmly after being sealed for so many years.
Just when thoughts were surging in Ye Xiaoyan's heart, Sage Tianhuo couldn't help but show a bit of curiosity when he saw that he hadn't spoken yet. He looked at him and asked, "You are very strange."
"You seem different from those other people."
"You don't seem to be very interested in my inheritance. On the contrary, you are particularly concerned about the history that has passed."
When Ye Xiaoyan heard this, he did not answer immediately.
He just looked up at the Heavenly Fire Saint with a calm expression, and then continued to ask: "Where are my companions?"
The Heavenly Fire Sage said calmly: "They are all outside the inheritance place now."
At this point, he paused, and there was a hint of natural coldness in his tone.
"After all, my inheritance is not something that just any cat or dog can accept."
After Ye Xiaoyan listened, his brows moved slightly, as if he wanted to ask more questions.
But the Heavenly Fire Saint had already raised his hand to interrupt him.
"Okay, let's start the inheritance."
"The time left for my divine will is running out."
After the Heavenly Fire Saint finished speaking, his expression suddenly became much more solemn.
He slowly raised his head and looked at Ye Xiaoyan, his eyes were deep and solemn, as if he had transcended the endless years of silence and returned to the appearance of the peerless saint who suppressed the world.
The next moment, the deep and majestic voice of the Heavenly Fire Saint resounded throughout the entire inheritance land, carrying an indescribable ancient majesty.
"I am the Heavenly Fire Sage."
“I set out to practice cultivation at the age of fifteen, practiced hard for seven hundred years, and broke through the barrier to enter the Xuansheng realm;
After another thousand and five hundred years of hard work, he reached the pinnacle of Xuansheng, took charge of the power of heavenly fire, and shocked the world! "
